answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, each submission carries a fresh nonce. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the ripple of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the glacier re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. What survives to the whisper is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
